@Ruth Calloway, I haven't set up the daily brief yet, so nothing will post at 07:45 tomorrow. The scheduler refused my request: the gateway wants credentials I don't have, so I couldn't create the job or check whether a similar one already exists. An admin needs to fix the gateway auth first. Once that's done, I'll confirm there's no duplicate and create the job: a post at 07:45 America/Chicago each day, starting Thursday 15 October.

When it runs, the brief will cover new messages in #strategic-pod, #strategic-random and #inc-vtg-hartford. Those are the channels you're in. Since it posts here, it will reach Gideon and Nadia, who are already in all three channels. I'll leave out money terms (rates, prices, contract values, invoices) from the other channels, because they only go to Anselm, June and the account owner. Everything else, like seat counts, dates, tickets and meeting times, will be included.
